mapper.select: SELECT a.public_id,o.order_no,a.order_id,o.customer_id,a.status FROM return_request a JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=a.order_id WHERE a.public_id=#{publicId}
SELECT a.public_id,o.order_no,a.order_id,o.customer_id,a.status FROM return_request a JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=a.order_id WHERE a.order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE return_request SET status=#{status},review_note=#{note},reviewed_by=#{operator},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND status='REQUESTED'
UPDATE return_request SET status='RECEIVED',receipt_note=#{note},received_by=#{operator},received_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE public_id=#{publicId} AND status='APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_request(public_id,order_id,amount) SELECT a.public_id,a.order_id,a.amount FROM return_request a JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=a.order_id JOIN payment p ON p.order_id=o.id WHERE a.public_id=#{publicId} AND a.status='RECEIVED' AND o.status='DELIVERED' AND a.amount=o.total_amount AND p.status='PAID' AND p.refund_status='PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM return_request a JOIN customer_order o ON o.id=a.order_id LEFT JOIN refund_request r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE a.status=#{status} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 200
